criteria.requirement: Add FormatChecker.compose(format, checker, *, mode="all", raises=()) for an existing registered format on this instance only, returning self. Combine the captured prior checker and new callable in order with all/any short circuit, preserving declared input-exception causes in FormatError and propagating undeclared programming errors. Keep original checks decorator overwrite semantics and independent/global checker registries unchanged. Reject unknown formats, invalid mode/callable/raises before mutation. Exercise actual builtin date syntax plus business conditions through FormatChecker and a real JSON Schema format keyword; no global monkeypatch or duplicated fake validation.
